svg.title: Six gametes after reciprocal translocation
svg.desc: Adjacent-1 gives 1 + 2 and 3 + 4. Adjacent-2 gives 1 + 3 and 2 + 4. Alternate gives 1 + 4 and 2 + 3. Chromosome 1 is derivative X (rb+), 2 is normal 2 (dp), 3 is normal Y, and 4 is derivative 2 (dp+). White zigzags mark the exchanged tips in the two derivatives.
